tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, OCC APIs | 5+ yrs E-Commerce Delivery
tailoring.summary: Backend specialist with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, micro-services, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and AI-assisted development. Strong techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, and production support in agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about adesso SE’s commitment to AI-driven digital transformation and its strong SAP portfolio. With 5+ years building SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can immediately contribute to your innovative projects.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features, covering product, catalog and pricing, using Java and Spring best practices.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Created and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party integrations, ensuring high performance and scalability.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Built robust PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved complex ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks across global teams.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Led CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performed code reviews, and supported production issues within Scrum teams, leveraging Docker and Kubernetes.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026 – I look forward to discussing how I can add value to adesso SE.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: Die AI-gestützte Digitalstrategie von adesso SE und Ihr Fokus auf SAP-Lösungen begeistern mich. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Know-how sofort ein.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Funktionen für Produkt-, Katalog- und Preismanagement mit Java und Spring nach Best Practices.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Erstellte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Web-Services sowie Headless-APIs für Storefronts und Drittanbieter-Integrationen, stets mit Fokus auf Performance.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenpipelines
bullets.text: Aufbau robuster PIM-zu-Hybris-Pipelines mittels Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub und Behebung komplexer ERP/MDM-Integrationsengpässe in internationalen Teams.

bullets.label: Agile Lieferung & CI/CD
bullets.text: Leitete CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2, führte Code-Reviews durch und unterstützte den Produktivbetrieb in Scrum-Teams unter Nutzung von Docker und Kubernetes.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026 – ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag bei adesso SE zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: adesso SE stands out as a leading German IT partner that combines deep SAP expertise with cutting-edge AI solutions. Your focus on creating intelligent, end-to-end commerce experiences aligns perfectly with my background in AI-assisted SAP Commerce development and large-scale integrations. Joining adesso means contributing to innovative projects while growing within a culture that values continuous learning and digital excellence.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to drive AI-enabled commerce solutions at adesso, a company renowned for digital innovation and strong SAP focus.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years experience at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to bring my API and integration expertise to adesso SE. Could we discuss potential opportunities?
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position. With over five years of hands-on experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to adesso SE.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application.
